title: 第一卷 第1章 抓妹子进树林
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
“我……我不是故意的。”

    “对不起。”

    李华伸手搓搓挨了一耳光的半边脸，眼神直勾勾的眼前给自己不断道歉的妙龄女孩，脸不是多疼，倒觉得很是蛋疼。

    人到中年，混的狗比倒灶，大半夜开着网约车，结果一辆大运逆行直直的撞过来。

    无处可躲。

    还好车上没载着乘客。

    没想到一睁眼就看到了他这辈子最对不起的女孩。

    张春妮！

    九八年。

    这一年的他，二十出头，年纪轻轻的，还是个舔狗。

    他喜欢的女孩说看张春妮不爽，他帮着出头，把张春妮拉到红树林吓唬了一顿。

    结果，正好被前来要赌债的债主张大雷撞见俩人从红树林出来。

    没多久。

    张春妮在红树林被他糟蹋的谣言传开，本来已经相好的婚事黄了，还被人指指点点，最终背井离乡，去外地打工。

    后来。

    在外地嫁人，她父母双亡，只有一个奶奶，没有娘家帮衬，嫁的人还是个家暴男，三天一小打，五天一大打，最终抱着一对双胞胎跳楼自杀。

    她奶奶帮着料理好后事，喝药也跟着走了。

    这一切的悲剧。

    他是始作俑者。

    他记忆深刻，为此后悔过无数次，做梦都想回到当初掐死当舔狗，助纣为虐的自己。

    没有想到。

    老天爷真是待他不薄。

    竟然给了他重新来过的机会。

    当回过神来，他发现……当舔狗只是一件微不足道的小事。

    无论如何，发生在张春妮身上的悲剧，都不能再发生。

    李华看着张春妮还在低着头道歉，他说道：“行了，你道什么歉。”

    “是我欺负你！”

    “挨打也是活该。”

    说完，他抬手给了自己一耳光，一点也没留劲，打的嘴角都往外渗血。

    可是和他造成张春妮未来的不幸相比，这点疼根本算不得什么，更无法弥补他对张春妮的伤害。

    张春妮害怕的身子发抖，在他抬手的瞬间，更是惊恐地用手挡住了脸。

    她以为自己要被打。

    李华暗道自己作孽！

    张春妮本就因为从小父母双亡，跟着奶奶长大，性格懦弱自卑内向，被他吓唬一通，估计已经吓破胆子了。

    只能接下来好好弥补，保护她，让未来的种种不幸，离她远远的！

    李华低声道：“刚才我是不小心，手滑碰了你……咳咳，该我向你道歉。”

    张春妮还是低着头，磕磕绊绊的说道：“没……没事。”

    “我……我可以走了吗？”
content_en:
"I...I didn't mean it."

    "I'm sorry."

    Li Hua stretched out his hand to rub the half of his face where he had been slapped. He looked directly at the young girl who was apologizing to him. His face was not sore, but his balls hurt.

    As a middle-aged man, he is always a mess. He is driving an online car-hailing car in the middle of the night, but a car traveling in the wrong direction bumps into him.

    There is nowhere to hide.

    Fortunately, there were no passengers in the car.

    Unexpectedly, when he opened his eyes, he saw the girl he felt most sorry for in his life.

    Zhang Chunni!

    Ninety-eight years.

    This year, he is in his early twenties. He is still a licker at a young age.

    The girl he liked said she was unhappy with Zhang Chunni, so he stepped in and dragged Zhang Chunni to the mangroves to scare her.

    As a result, the debtor Dalei happened to come to collect gambling debts and saw the two of them coming out of the mangrove.

    It didn't take long.

    Rumors spread that Zhang Chunni had been raped by him in the mangrove forest. The marriage they were already in love with was ruined, and she was criticized by others. Eventually, she left her hometown and went to work in other places.

    later.

    When she got married out of town, both of her parents died, she had only one grandmother, and no support from her natal family. The man she married was a domestic violence man, who beat her a little every three days and a dozen every five days. Finally, she committed suicide by jumping off a building with a pair of twins in her arms.

    Her grandma helped with the funeral arrangements and took the medicine along with her.

    The tragedy of it all.

    He was the instigator.

    He has a profound memory and has regretted this countless times. In his dreams, he wants to go back to the time when he strangled a dog to death and helped others do evil.

    Didn't expect that.

    God was really kind to him.

    It actually gave him a chance to start over.

    When he came back to his senses, he realized that being a dog licker was just a trivial matter.

    No matter what, the tragedy that happened to Zhang Chunni can never happen again.

    Li Hua saw that Zhang Chunni was still lowering her head to apologize, and he said, "Okay, what are you apologizing for?"

    "I bullied you!"

    "You deserve the beating."

    After saying that, he raised his hand and slapped himself without any force, causing blood to ooze from the corners of his mouth.

    But compared with the misfortune he caused Zhang Chunni in the future, this pain was nothing, let alone the harm he caused to Zhang Chunni.

    Zhang Chunni was trembling with fear, and the moment he raised his hand, she even covered her face with her hands in fear.

    She thought she was going to be beaten.

    Li Hua secretly thought that he was guilty!

    Zhang Chunni's parents died when she was young and she grew up with her grandma. She has a weak and low self-esteem and is introverted. After being frightened by him, she was probably scared out of her wits.

    We can only make up for it next, protect her, and keep all kinds of misfortunes away from her in the future!

    Li Hua whispered: "I accidentally touched you with my hand just now... Ahem, it's my turn to apologize to you."

    Zhang Chuni still lowered her head and said stumblingly: "No...it's okay."

    "I...can I go?"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 1 Catching a girl into the woods
